children: In a market short on fresh triggers, several stocks quietly grabbed attention on September 9, driven by technical breakouts, strong price action, and sustained buying interest.
The selected stocks are showing strong upward momentum, trading well above their key short- to medium-term moving averages, which indicates a positive trend in the near term.
Orient Green stock rose 7.64% to ₹10.28, trading above its 30-day (₹9.55) and 50-day (₹9.80) averages. It is marginally below the 150-day (₹10.30) and 200-day (₹10.64) averages.
Corona Remedies stock rose 6.42% to ₹2,236.20, trading above its 30-day (₹2,101.25) and 50-day (₹2,077.19) averages. It is also above its 150-day (₹1,795.80) average.
Innovision stock rose 5.70% to ₹286.85, trading above its 30-day (₹271.39) and 50-day (₹277.90) averages.
The selected stocks are witnessing downward pressure, as reflected in negative price movements and their positioning relative to key moving averages, indicating a cautious market sentiment.

Tokyo Plast stock fell 4.59% to ₹74.58, trading below its 30-day (₹78.17), 50-day (₹80.42), 150-day (₹83.46) and 200-day (₹90.28) averages, indicating weakness across both short- and long-term trends.

Future Market stock declined 3.37% to ₹9.17, trading below its 30-day (₹9.49), 50-day (₹9.63), 150-day (₹9.32) and 200-day (₹9.25) averages, signalling continued weakness across all key moving averages.

Kronox Lab Scie stock fell 3.08% to ₹166.88, trading below its 30-day (₹172.18) average but above its 50-day (₹164.39), 150-day (₹140.58) and 200-day (₹139.58) averages, indicating short-term weakness while the medium- and long-term trend remains positive.

Meanwhile, several stocks touched fresh 52-week high, highlighting persistent buying. Notable names touching new high included Graphite India, Finolex Cables, One 97, Chennai Petro, Navin Fluorine, Sai Life Sciences, Redington, Anthem Biosciences, Laurus Labs, Neuland Lab, Divis Labs, Solar Industreis.

On the other hand, HDFC Life, ICICI Prudential, Wipro, Bikaji Foods, Dabur India, HDFC Bank, HUL, Swan Corp, Bayer CropSciences, ICICI Lombard, Voltas, SBI Life Insurance, IRCTC, United Breweries, Indiamart Intermesh, JK Lakshmi Cemenet, Kama Holdings, HEG touched 52-week low.
Goa Carbon, Grand Foundry, ESDS Software among others were locked in their upper circuits, reflecting strong buying and signalling bullish near-term sentiment.

title: Momentum Stocks: Goa Carbon, Grand Foundry, ESDS Software locked at upper circuit
